query:
UPDATE molecules 
SET `references` = JSON_ARRAY(
  JSON_OBJECT(
    'type', 'pubchem',
    'title', 'Geosmin - PubChem Compound Summary',
    'url', 'https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/Geosmin',
    'year', 2024
  ),
  JSON_OBJECT(
    'type', 'academic',
    'author', 'Gerber, N.N.',
    'year', 1968,
    'title', 'Geosmin, from microorganisms, is trans-1,10-dimethyl-trans-9-decalol',
    'journal', 'Tetrahedron Letters',
    'doi', '10.1016/S0040-4039(01)99023-1'
  ),
  JSON_OBJECT(
    'type', 'academic',
    'author', 'Jüttner, F. & Watson, S.B.',
    'year', 2007,
    'title', 'Biochemical and ecological control of geosmin and 2-methylisoborneol in source waters',
    'journal', 'Applied and Environmental Microbiology',
    'doi', '10.1128/AEM.02250-06'
  )
)
WHERE id = 1;
